matchedRules.reason: Current OS Trace gateway and Trace Burn changes must prove authenticated history paging, canonical TraceStore resolution, safe redaction, and OS-owned virtual-list/browser behavior.

OS release orchestration, GitHub CLI resolution, signed runtime publication/promotion, exact local update handoff, default workspace-shell snapshots, and Workspace Edge migrations must prove the focused freshness path without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.
OS dependency lock changes must prove the exact frozen Bun install contract used by distribution and release workflows without selecting unrelated package-wide tests.

Lifecycle updater, managed ingress dependency convergence, Caddy topology reload decisions, immutable release handoff, worker drain/load-balancer evacuation, detached activation, platform restart, and discoverable lifecycle-tool changes must run the exact lifecycle/facade/tool contracts without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Work-session filesystem authority must prove trusted session-root routing, escape resistance, generated tool contracts, and unchanged task-session filesystem behavior without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.
